scripts.stop:3000: for /f "tokens=5" %a in ('netstat -aon ^| findstr :3000 ^| findstr LISTENING') do taskkill /F /PID %a
scripts.stop:8000: for /f "tokens=5" %a in ('netstat -aon ^| findstr :8000 ^| findstr LISTENING') do taskkill /F /PID %a
scripts.stop:ports: npm run stop:3000 & npm run stop:8000
scripts.dev:all:clean: npm run stop:ports & npm run dev:all
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:all:full: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
